unavailable: Local storage could not be opened: the system keychain denies access to the key. Your data has not been changed. Unlock the keychain, then restart minim.
reducedProtection: Reduced protection: no keychain is available on this system, so the key to your data is kept in a file protected only by your account's permissions.

recovered.key_lost: The key to your local data was lost (reinstallation or new profile). The old database was set aside and a new one was created.
recovered.key_mismatch: Your local data could not be decrypted. The old database was set aside and a new one was created.
recovered.corrupted: Your local data was damaged. The old database was set aside and a new one was created.
